note: Neither AWAL nor The Orchard publishes a complete store list. AWAL states 100+ partners without naming them; The Orchard publishes a dated list (it still names defunct services). Rows with source jovie-target are services Tim listed that are not confirmed in either public document.

awal-faq.claim: AWAL supplies more than 100 digital partners in nearly 200 territories, including all of the leading platforms (no names).

awal-blog.claim: Directly distributes to Apple Music, Spotify, Amazon, YouTube, Google Play, Pandora, etc.; Kobalt job listing adds Facebook, TikTok.

awal-third-party.claim: Third-party guide lists Tidal, YouTube Music (unconfirmed by AWAL).

orchard-store-list.claim: FAQ: What streaming stores does The Orchard distribute to? Official dated list of 43 names.

jovie-target.claim: Tim 2026-11-07 ask: support every DSP AWAL/Orchard distribute to; listed services not confirmed in either public document.
